name: luh-u_q-osp-3-2-invariant-quantum-chains
notes:
Bethe ansatz data (roots, finite size energies and conformal weights) for low energy states of the integrable $U_q[OSp(3|2)]$-invariant superspin chain.

For details see Holger Frahm and Márcio J. Martins: "$U_q[OSp(3|2)]$ quantum chains with quantum group invariant boundaries", Nucl. Phys. B __995__ (2023) 116329 [arXiv:2307.09412]
title: Finite size data for U_q[OSp(3|2)] quantum chains with quantum group invariant  boundaries

resources.description:
$U_q[OSp(3|2)]$ quantum chains with quantum group invariant boundaries, Holger Frahm, Márcio J. Martins

Abstract: Based on the finite-size analysis of the spectrum of the quantum group invariant deformation of the OSp(3|2) superspin chain we identify the operator content of the conformal field theory describing the model in its scaling limit. We find that the macroscopic degeneracy of the conformal weights observed in the thermodynamic limit of the isotropic superspin chain is lifted by the deformation.
resources.name: Nucl. Phys. B 995 (2023)  116329

resources.description:
Bethe roots and finite size spectral data for the lowest states with spin j=0,1,2,3 of the quantum group invariant U_q[SU(2)] spin chain with gamma=2pi/9.

Note that the Bethe roots are rescaled by a factor gamma as compared to the notation in the paper.

resources.description:
Bethe roots and finite size spectral data for the first excitation with spin j=0 of the quantum group invariant U_q[SU(2)] spin chain with even length and gamma=2pi/9, 2pi/7, 9pi/25, 3pi/7, pi/2.

Note that the Bethe roots are rescaled by a factor gamma as compared to the notation in the paper.
